paper_title: Constraints on dark photons and axion-like particles from SuperCDMS Soudan
notes: SuperCDMS Soudan sets limits on both axioelectric coupling g_ae (ALPs) and dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon over mass range 40 eV to 500 keV. Both couplings equally weighted in paper; reported here as AxionElectron per hint. Values approximate, read from abstract/text (g_ae below 1e-12 for few-hundred eV masses); no numerical table provided in accessible content, data points are rough estimates from exclusion curve (Fig 12). Strongest laboratory limit for 40-186 eV. Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed. If DarkPhoton chosen instead, epsilon below 1e-15 near 100 eV. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.45, 7))
